elaine: Quick sync — scheduled change window tomorrow 00:30 UTC: small runtime flag roll + rolling restarts of a subset of Dedicated pools. Low risk but want customer-facing copy ready (statuspage one-liner, short email, ops FAQ + pin command). Who can draft?
deploy-bot: schedule=2026-10-12T00:30:00Z; canary=10m; rollout=45m; auto-rollback=on_error_rate>6%_for_5m; notify=#eng-platform.
mohit_ops: Ill own pins and the runbook. Will compile list of customers to auto-pin (p50 < 100ms) and hand off to support by 18:00 UTC.
tara_support: Ill draft the messages. Posting drafts below for review.
tara_support: STATUSPAGE: "Maintenance: rolling runtime update for Dedicated inference pools in select regions. You may see brief request interruptions while pools restart. Live updates will be posted on our status page. Window: 00:30UTC  02:00 UTC."
tara_support: EMAIL (impacted customers): "Subject: Notice: Redwood runtime update — 00:30 UTC

Hello,

We will perform a routine runtime update and rolling restarts of a subset of Dedicated inference pools starting at 00:30 UTC. Impact: during restarts some requests may see short interruptions or retries.

If your account is on our critical SLA list we will pin your workloads to the prior runtime snapshot for the duration. We will monitor metrics and automatically rollback if error rates exceed safety thresholds. We will send a follow-up once the rollout completes or if we pause/rollback.

No action required unless this conflicts with a strict production freeze. To request manual pinning or a different window reply to this email or contact support@redwood.com.

Thanks,
Redwood Inference Operations"
mohit_ops: OPS FAQ (short): - What customers see: short 502/503s or retries; most traffic served from warm pools. - Pinning: auto-pin list applied 15m before window. - Rollback/hold: canary hold if quality/error thresholds hit; auto-rollback on sustained error >6% over 5m. - Post-rollout: export token-level cost delta + 5-sample quality diff for product.
mohit_ops: PIN COMMAND (internal example):
```
curl -X POST "https://internal-api.redwood/v1/pins" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OP_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"customer_id":"cust-900","route":"/v1/chat","model":"rwd-13b-q","version":"2026-09-30"}'
```
raul_product: please add a reassuring sentence to the email: "If generation quality is affected we will pause the rollout and notify impacted customers immediately."
tara_support: added. Also will schedule statuspage publish 30m before window and email at T+7 into canary. Will include localized time conversions and support alias.
elaine: final: keep edits in this thread only. Mohit  send the auto-pin list to Tara by 18:00 UTC. Deploy-bot should post any schedule changes here automatically. Flag anything urgent in this thread. :white_check_mark:
